input.question: EL15: What is work-study?
input.ground_truth: Work study is a government aid program based on need. To become eligible, your parents must complete the fafsa for next school year. When your school looks at this information, they can let you know what amount of subsidized/unsubsidized loans you can take out. Federal work study is also an option that will probably be on your summary. It was on mine. I received a certain amount of money that I could earn that semester. I found a job on campus and earned $7.25/ HR that was deducted from that specified amount before school started. I didn't end up earning all the money. My job on campus was in the HR department, but there were lots of other options like career services, athletics, the library, and the fitness center. Hope this helps.
